blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The Sourcify-matched DebtToken implementation restricts fixed invalid recipient sinks and protocol burn callers; it has no arbitrary holder denylist. Filecoin block 6458485 (2026-10-15T10:42:30Z) confirms the live implementation, transparent-proxy administrator and unchanged 2-of-3 Safe. Immediate upgrades can replace transfer logic, so possible remains the holder-restriction verdict. The executable-runtime match does not imply exact metadata equality or verification of every core contract.

oracleRisk.summary: RedStone FIL/USD is primary; the Tellor fallback depends on Secured Finance's roughly 12-hour update job. The owner Safe can replace oracle addresses, and cached prices expire after 48 hours.

branchApplicability.rationale: The single FIL Trove market has liquidation thresholds, Stability Pool, redistribution and oracle failure behavior that require one collateral branch.

sources.label: PriceFeed owner-only oracle replacement and timeout logic

branches.label: Filecoin FIL Troves
branches.summary: One FIL market uses RedStone with operator-submitted Tellor fallback and last-good-price caching.

feeds.path: FIL/USD -> PriceFeed -> FIL Trove collateral ratios

branches.fallbackBehavior: Primary timeout is 16 hours. Failed or invalid responses or a more-than-doubled/halved price trigger fallback checks; returning to the primary generally requires agreement within 5%. If both feeds fail, the last good price remains usable for 48 hours after storage, then price-sensitive operations revert. The PriceFeed owner, the recorded Safe at the pin, can replace both oracle addresses.

collateralParameters.note: Recovery Mode begins below 150% system collateralization; minimum net Trove debt is 200 USDFC, plus a 20 USDFC liquidation reserve.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Permissionless liquidation offsets debt with Stability Pool deposits and redistributes uncovered debt and collateral. In Recovery Mode, Troves at or above 110% and below system TCR require full Stability Pool debt coverage; collateral seizure is capped at 110% of debt.
branches.backstop: Funded Stability Pool with redistribution to surviving FIL Troves; deposits are variable.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Recovery Mode tightens borrowing below 150% system collateralization. Oracle outage eventually halts price-sensitive operations; no emergency shutdown or loss-recovery guarantee is established.
